text: Andrew said he started a new job as a Financial Analyst in the week of 20 March 2023, which he described as quite a change from his previous job.
Audrey said she had got new collars and tags for her dogs and shared a photo of two of them standing in the grass wearing the new collars, which she thought was cute.
Audrey said she has had her three dogs, named Pepper, Precious and Panda, for 3 years and that she cannot live without her little ones.
Audrey said her dogs are city dogs who explore all the time, love trying out new parks and trails, and go on adventures together very often.
Andrew said he was kind of jealous of the fun outings Audrey has with her dogs, which she said bring her a great deal of happiness.
Andrew said he has no pets at the moment but loves animals, and that he has always been awed by birds because of their power to soar and explore new spots.
Andrew said eagles have always mesmerized him because they are so strong and graceful, and he shared a photo of two birds flying in the sky with the sun shining behind them.
Andrew said he has not gone bird-watching specifically, but he does spot birds when he goes hiking.
Andrew recommended Fox Hollow as a great trail to hike on weekends because of its awesome views, and Audrey said she would give it a try.
Andrew asked Audrey to let him know how she likes the Fox Hollow trail, and Audrey said she would let him know after she tried it.
Audrey told Andrew on 2 April 2023 that the family had adopted another puppy called Pixie, and shared a photo of a small white dog sitting on a carpet.
Audrey said Pixie is fitting in great with the other dogs, after it took her a few days to get used to them, and that the dogs now love playing and exploring the house together.
Audrey said Pepper took a bit of time to get used to Pixie, but by 2 April 2023 the two dogs were always together.
Audrey said she had not yet checked out the hiking spot Andrew recommended in their earlier conversation, because Pixie had been keeping the household busy.
Andrew said he was considering getting a dog too, but finding a dog-friendly place in the city is challenging, so he asked Audrey for tips on finding one.
Audrey said she and her family used websites with filters that let them find a place that allowed dogs, and that they found a perfect spot thanks to those websites.
Andrew said he would give the dog-friendly place websites that Audrey suggested a try, and he said he hopes to find a great spot and a furry friend soon.
Andrew said his family has a dog and shared a photo of it sitting on a couch in a living room, and he said it would be fun to hang out with a dog and cuddle away.
Andrew said he misses exploring nature trails with his family's dog, and that hiking with a dog is a great way to bond with it and create memories together.
Andrew said he needs to find a dog-friendly spot soon so he can get exploring again, and that he will keep looking until he finds one.
Audrey said her furry friends make great cuddle buddies and shared a photo of one of her dogs enjoying lazy couch time on a couch with a pillow.
Andrew said that in the weekend of 8 to 9 April 2023 he and his girlfriend tried out a new cafe in the city, which was super fun but left him sad about not being out in nature.
Andrew said being out in nature is where he feels he is really thriving, that nature feels like a home for his soul, and that he misses the peacefulness of being out on a hike.
Andrew said living in the city makes it hard to take dogs for walks in a park, so he really misses the connection and companionship, and sometimes it feels like he is missing out.
Audrey said that taking her dogs for a walk in the park helps her find her center and recharges her.
Audrey agreed with Andrew that being out in nature, surrounded by beauty and peace, is unbeatable compared with being surrounded by concrete jungles, and said nature brings us back down to earth.
Andrew said he and his girlfriend love to discover new places to eat around town, which is a great way to try something new and wind down after a long week.
Andrew said he and his girlfriend found an awesome cafe with amazing pastries and shared a photo of a bakery display with pastries and coffee.
Andrew said that at the cafe they had delicious croissants, muffins and tarts, and that the pastries tasted great.
Audrey said she made some of her favourite treats in the week of 9 April 2023 and proposed having a pastry party sometime, sharing a photo of a muffin pan filled with blueberry muffins.
Andrew said he was counting himself in for Audrey's proposed pastry party and that he was excited to see all the dogs together at the party.
Audrey said her dogs would tag along to the pastry party, and that it would be a good chance for Andrew to hang out with them.
Audrey said she has had tattoos of her dogs on her arm for a while, which represent her love for her pups and nature's beauty, and she shared a photo of the tattoo of a dog and sunflowers.
Audrey said she has always had a strong bond with her dogs, that they make her so happy, and that she just wants to see their happy faces even when they are not with her.
Audrey said that in the week of 24 April 2023 she finally went on a hike and had an amazing experience watching a hummingbird dart around with its wings, and she shared a photo of it on a branch.

Andrew said he had been feeling down because he could not get out much, but by 3 May 2023 he had found a new open space to hike nearby which feels so refreshing, and he shared a photo of a lake and mountains at sunset.
Andrew said he usually tries to escape the city at least once a weekend, which he described as his much-needed break.
Andrew said nature is therapeutic for him, and that standing on top of a mountain breathing in fresh air feels so peaceful and invigorating, and he shared a photo of a mountain range at sunset.
Andrew said he tries to capture special moments in nature and share that feeling with others, because he finds that spreading peace and positivity brings him joy.
Audrey said that as of 3 May 2023 not much had changed since the last talk, and that she is busy taking care of her pets and spending time with them, which she finds really fulfilling.
Audrey said her dogs go nuts when they go on hikes, loving new scents and being in nature, which she described as their happy place.
Audrey said safety is super important to her and that she got her dogs special gear, shown in a photo of a dog wearing a leash and shoes, which she said looks funny but works.
Audrey said that when she takes her dogs out they play fetch with a ball or frisbee, and they meet other dog owners in the park for doggy playdates.
Audrey said her dogs do not mind wearing party hats, which they put on just for fun and treats, and she shared a photo of a dog wearing a party hat on a couch.
Audrey recommended the dog park as a great place to start for playdates, saying it is right by the park they usually walk and has lots of trees and benches for watching the dogs play.
Andrew said he would check out the dog park that Audrey recommended, noting that it is not too far away from him.
Andrew said that since the last conversation he has been looking for a dog to adopt, browsing websites, visiting shelters and asking friends of theirs, which he described as both fun and annoying.
Andrew said that for a person living in an apartment, a smaller dog would be best, while an active person should consider a breed that loves to play and run.
Andrew said finding a pet-friendly place to live has been tough, so he is contacting landlords and checking out neighbourhoods to find the perfect spot.
Andrew said he wants to live near a park or woods so he can stay close to nature and give the dog a large open space to run around.
Audrey said she is lucky to have a park near her home, which is great for her pup's walks in the neighbourhood.
Audrey said that on Friday 5 May 2023 she took her dogs on a road trip to a beautiful national park where they had a blast, and she shared a photo of three dogs running through a field of grass.
Audrey said she takes her dogs on road trips once every couple of months, as a way for them to explore and stay active.
Andrew said he really wishes he could go on a road trip with a furry companion, and he has added that to his bucket list.
Audrey offered to help Andrew with his search for a dog, saying she would be expecting a photo of his dog soon and would give suggestions if he needed them.
Andrew said he had a great hike with some friends and his girlfriend at a spot they had found recently, in the weekend of 6 to 7 May 2023, and that nature was so peaceful.
Audrey said that as of 11 May 2023 she had been taking care of her four dogs and making sure they were happy and healthy, which took up most of her free time that week.
Audrey said she had signed up for a workshop about bonding with her pet next month, meaning June 2023, which she was excited to attend to strengthen her bond with her pets.
Audrey said she heard about the workshop from a flyer at her local pet store, and that it was a positive reinforcement training class, where a volunteer let her meet their friendly and playful dog.
Audrey said she is sure her dogs will catch on quickly because they are quick learners who love rewards, and she promised to keep Andrew updated on their progress.
Audrey said pets should learn to behave through positive reinforcement and that punishment is never the proper way to train pets, because she does not want to hurt any of her dogs.
Andrew said he would not want to be punished, let alone puppies and dogs, and that he would look into the classes that Audrey mentioned.
Audrey said that on 1 June 2023 she took her pups to the park, where it was awesome to see them running around and playing without a leash, which filled her heart with joy.
Audrey said that in the week of 26 May 2023 she took her dogs hiking at a national park and made it to a beautiful peak that was stunning at sunset.
Audrey said her dogs were running around on that hike, the breeze was nice, birds were chirping, and the whole trip felt like a slice of paradise that she will never forget.
Audrey shared a photo of two horses in a field with a fence, saying it was one of her favourite photos from the sunset trip she took to the national park.
Andrew said he is still searching for a furry friend, finds pet-friendly spots in the city tough, and feels discouraged but determined to find the right place and dog.
Audrey offered to help Andrew find a great spot for his furry friend and asked him to email her his criteria, saying that they would keep searching together.
Audrey said that nature always cheers her up and makes her feel grateful, and that she was glad Andrew could experience the sunset trip too.
Andrew said that on Sunday 11 June 2023 he and his friends took a rock climbing class and he made it to the top, which was a fantastic experience that left him hooked.
Andrew shared a photo of the view from the top of the rock he climbed during the class, and said he was really proud of the achievement.
Andrew said the climb was tricky because he is still a newbie, but he made it with the support and cheers of his friends.
Andrew said he plans to do more outdoor activities every week, such as kayaking and maybe bungee jumping, because nature always pushes him out of his comfort zone.
Audrey said that in the week of 5 June 2023 she found a great spot for her dogs' walk, a small park with a trail surrounded by trees, and invited Andrew to come along.
Andrew accepted Audrey's invitation to join her and her pups for a walk in the park, saying that being in nature with dogs sounds like a great time.
Audrey said her dogs love meeting new people and that she usually walks them for about an hour, letting them explore at their own pace.
Audrey said her dogs always go home with a smile and tired after walks, and that their faces brighten up as soon as she gets ready for a walk, which is their favourite part of the day.
Audrey said that being outdoors with her dogs puts her in her happy place, and that dogs and nature bring her so much joy and peace.
Audrey shared a photo of two dogs playing with a frisbee in a field and said her dogs make her so happy in that meadow.
Andrew said that whenever he is in need of a reset he turns to nature, which he says refreshes the mind and gives a different outlook on things.
Audrey said that by 26 June 2023 she had moved to a new place with a bigger backyard for her dogs, and she shared a photo of two dogs sitting on the grass in front of the house.
Audrey said she set up a doggy play area in her new backyard with agility equipment and toys, and that her dogs are loving it.
Andrew said he is at a doggy daycare near him that has a big indoor space for dogs to play, and he shared a photo of a group of dogs playing with a ball in a large indoor area.
Audrey said she would definitely take a look at the doggy daycare that Andrew mentioned, and that she would like to take her dogs there sometime soon.
Andrew offered to help Audrey find more places for dogs, saying it was not a problem at all, and Audrey said she appreciated the offer.
Audrey said she does not understand people who hate on pets or even hurt them, since pets are like family to the people who love them.
Andrew said that on Friday 23 June 2023 he hiked with some friends, the weather was great, and they got some awesome pictures that he had not gone through yet.
Andrew said that during the hike he enjoyed being outdoors, hearing the bird songs and smelling the trees, and that he has been really missing the connection with nature and the peace it brings.
Andrew shared a photo of a flower bed with many different coloured flowers from a park in his neighbourhood and asked Audrey what was new with her.
Audrey said that apart from moving house, her recent time has mostly been spent unpacking the boxes that were packed up for the move.
Audrey said that a few years back she and her friends went on a hike and stumbled across a stunning lake in the mountains, where they sat, chatted and admired the peacefulness of nature.
Audrey said she really wants to do something like that lakeside hike right now, and she hopes Andrew gets to experience nature again soon.
Audrey said she is taking a dog training course that is challenging but rewarding, and that as of 3 July 2023 her dogs were already doing better.
Andrew said life had thrown him a few curveballs and that he still could not find any dog-friendly spots to rent, which he called a bummer, as of 3 July 2023.
Audrey said the dog-training course has been a big time sink but has paid off because her dogs are doing great, and that she has not had much time for new trails.
Andrew said that for now it is just urban adventures for him, because he understands how it feels to miss the peace of being out on the trails.
Audrey said her dogs are all mutts, with two Jack Russell mixes and two Chihuahua mixes, and that they love running and playing fetch.
Audrey said her dogs are all 3 years old and had a doggy playdate on Friday 30 June 2023 that was a bit crazy but still lots of fun.
Andrew said that since he cannot hike he has been finding new hobbies, mainly getting into cooking and trying out new recipes, which he has found enjoyable.

Audrey said her favourite recipe is Chicken Pot Pie, which is her family's recipe that has been around for years and reminds her of her grandma's kitchen, and she offered to send the recipe to Andrew.
Andrew said cooking has been helping him de-stress and be creative, and that although he is still a rookie he is having fun experimenting in the kitchen.
Audrey said cooking is like an escape for her, a way to de-stress and let her creativity flow, and that she loves throwing on some music and pouring a glass of wine while cooking.
Audrey said garlic is her go-to ingredient in the kitchen, because she loves the smell and taste it adds to dishes.
Audrey said roasted chicken is one of her favourite dishes, based on her love for Mediterranean flavours, with healthy ingredients such as chicken, garlic, lemon and herbs.
Andrew said he is always looking for new meal ideas, especially healthier ones, and that he will keep Audrey posted on how the recipes turn out.
Andrew said that on Friday 7 July 2023 he had a picnic with his girlfriend that was so much fun, and that being in nature is refreshing and always brings him joy.
Audrey said her furry friends always make her happy, and that she and her dogs had a great walk the other day which felt really good.
Andrew said he wishes he could get a dog but it is tough to find a place and the right dog, and he asked Audrey how she got hers.
Audrey said she got lucky finding a breeder nearby that had the dogs she wanted, and that places that allow dogs are really hard to find.
Andrew said he has found a few parks where you can take a pup on a leash, but that it is not the same as an open area where dogs can run and play.
Audrey said she should join Andrew for a hike and bring her dogs, because it would be great to have a chance for them to run freely.

Andrew proposed a hike with Audrey and her dogs for next month, meaning August 2023, when the weather is more pleasant, and shared a photo of a steep trail with a view of the ocean that he thought would suit dogs.
Andrew shared a map of the park trail for planning and said they should make sure the trail is safe for the dogs to run around and have fun.
Audrey said she would look into the trail for her dogs to run around, and agreed that safety is top priority when dogs are outside running around.

Audrey said that on 8 July 2023 there would be some cool stuff happening that day, and she shared a photo of three dogs sitting on the floor with leashes, saying they were all set for their next outdoor adventure.
Audrey said her dogs have tons of energy and always bring a smile to her face, and she shared a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouths.
Audrey said she is 100% sure the hike will be a great day, and she shared a photo of her dogs playing with a group of other dogs at their local park.
Audrey shared a photo of a person standing on a mountain with a view of the sky from a hike she did last year, which she said was a 3 hour drive from where she lives.
Andrew asked where the sunset photo was taken, and Audrey said she hiked there last year, a 3 hour drive from her home, and that the sunset was amazing.
Audrey said she is grateful for moments in nature that remind her of its beauty and help her appreciate the small things, and she shared a photo of a view of a lake and mountains at sunset.

Andrew said that nature has awesome surprises and that life is pretty awesome when we take time to appreciate these moments, and Audrey agreed that taking a second to appreciate them makes life better.
Andrew introduced Toby, his new puppy, to Audrey on 11 July 2023, saying he could not resist taking him home despite city living, and shared a photo of Toby sitting on a leash in a room.
Andrew said that since they last talked work has been piling up and he has been stuck inside, and that he misses the peace and feeling of freedom that comes with going on a hike.
Andrew said he has plans for a hike next month, meaning August 2023, and invited Audrey and her pups to come along so they could all enjoy nature together.
Audrey accepted Andrew's invitation to the hike, saying her dogs could come too, and shared a photo of wooden keychains with engraved names that she had made as personalised tags for her dogs.
Audrey said she made the tags herself because she wanted each one to be special and to fit its dog's personality, and that she wants her pets to feel seen and loved.
Andrew said he and Audrey were both counting down to the hike, and that he was looking forward to Toby and Audrey's dogs meeting each other.
Andrew said small things like handmade personalised tags show how much people care about their pets, and Audrey said small acts of love make a big difference in relationships with furry pals.
Andrew said he and his girlfriend had a great experience volunteering at a pet shelter on Monday 24 July 2023, which was very rewarding and reminded him how much he loves animals.
Audrey said she had never been to an animal shelter before but thought volunteering would be great, and that she should volunteer at one someday.
Audrey said she has four dogs that are more important to her than anything, and she shared a photo of herself kissing a dog in a park.

Audrey described her four dogs' personalities: the oldest is relaxed like a wise old sage, the second is always ready for a game, the third is naughty but loves a cuddle, and the youngest is full of life.

Audrey said her childhood dog Max had lots of energy and loved a game of fetch, and that when she was a kid she and Max took long walks in the neighbourhood, where she shared her worries and hopes with him.
Andrew said the photo of Audrey with her childhood dog made the dog look like the most playful one ever, and that pets become friends and confidantes who provide comfort when we need it.
Andrew said volunteering with animals has been one of the most rewarding things he has ever done, and that he and his girlfriend volunteer to give back and make the animals' lives better.
Audrey said she is sure the pet shelter appreciated the couple's help and that their kindness and care would make the animals happier.
Andrew said that for the weekend of 5 to 6 August 2023 he, his girlfriend and Toby were going camping, because it had been forever since he had been in nature.
Audrey said she had just started agility classes with her pups at a dog park, and that watching them learn and build relationships with other dogs warms her heart.
Audrey said she takes her dogs to the park twice a week for agility practice, which she described as a great physical and mental workout and a bonding experience for them.
Audrey said a recent trail hike took her and her dogs two hours and had lots of amazing views, and she shared a photo of herself walking her dogs down a path.
Andrew said hiking is the best outdoor activity for him, and that reaching the top of a challenging trail makes all his worries vanish.
Andrew said nature calms him down and relaxes his mind, and that being out in it feels like a break from the craziness of city living.
Audrey said her pets have been her good buddies during all the tough times, and that they are her companions who always make her day better.
Andrew said he hopes to have a deep bond with Toby one day, and he shared a photo of a stream running through a lush green forest.
Audrey asked what breed Toby is, and Andrew said Toby is a German Shepherd, which he described as smart and loyal.
Audrey said German Shepherds are super loyal and smart, and that Andrew will have an amazing connection with one.
Andrew said he wants to take Toby hiking because German Shepherds would make great hiking buddies, being so smart and loyal.
Audrey advised Andrew that city dog owners must have enough time and energy for a pup, and that a German Shepherd like Toby needs lots of attention and walks to offset his energy.
Andrew said he will keep in mind not to limit Toby's growth while also not taking him out too little, and he planned to take Toby on a small hike at the local trail.
